Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 1, Verse 35

“I do not wish to kill these, Madhusudana, even if they should kill me — not for the rulership of the three worlds, how much less for the earth.”

The offer he refuses keeps growing: not for this kingdom, not even for all three worlds. And he includes the case where they kill him first, which rules out self-defence as an answer.
